blind.description: A stylized fantasy short sword or dagger consisting of a double-edged steel blade with a wide fuller, a thick metallic crossguard with gold trim, a brown/reddish leather-wrapped grip, and a rounded pommel with a gold inset. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully manifold with hand-painted textures, floating or propped at an angle off the ground without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: Seen directly edge-on as a thin horizontal strip pointing to the right, showing the crossguard width and circular pommel on the left, casting a distinct sword silhouette shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: The sword is roughly 2 to 2.5 feet long from pommel to tip (a little over one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in cylinder), and around 8 to 10 inches wide across the guard.
